description: This file implements a web worker class (_SQLiteWorker) for managing SQLite database operations, including opening, preparing statements, executing queries, closing, exporting, and deleting databases, with support for VFS and encryption. It also sets up message handling for worker initialization.

classes.name: _SQLiteWorker
classes.description: A class managing SQLite database operations within a web worker context, including connection, statement preparation, execution, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the SQLite database connection with specified options, including loading the appropriate SQLite module asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with caching and retries to handle flaky preparation processes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a prepared statement with optional parameters, returning query results or performing non-query operations.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an SQL command, handling database decryption and initialization, returning query or affected rows info.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and finalizes all prepared statements.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the database as a stream for backup or transfer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the database and associated VFS.

methods.name: getVFS
methods.description: Retrieves the Virtual File System (VFS) instance based on the database name and async flag.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the database, including registering extensions and dispatching an event.

methods.name: waitForDatabase
methods.description: Waits for the database to be initialized if it isn't already.
